title: Global Chat
intent: Create one academy-wide, safe, low-friction community conversation space that helps active learners ask, answer, and connect outside a single course context.
businessValue: increase learner belonging and return frequency
create a moderated cross-course community layer

actors.goal: read and participate in the academy-wide conversation
keep conversation safe, relevant, and recoverable
set policy, appoint moderators, and review escalations
enforce eligibility, delivery, unread, and moderation outcomes

eligibility.read: authenticated active academy member unless chat-banned
eligibility.write: authenticated active academy member unless muted or chat-banned

journeys: discover Global Chat from persistent academy navigation and open the shared room
catch up from the last-read point and see unread and mention indicators
post a text message, reply to a message, react, edit own message, or remove own message
report a message or member and immediately hide that content for the reporter
moderator reviews a report, dismisses it, removes content, mutes a member, bans a member, or escalates it
community admin reviews escalations and restores or confirms moderation outcomes
rules: Global Chat is one academy-wide public-to-members room, not a direct-message or course-specific channel.
Only eligible authenticated members can read or write; membership and chat sanctions are enforced at every operation.
Text, emoji, reactions, replies, mentions, and safe links are MVP content; file, image, audio, video, voice, and live calls are out of MVP.
An author can edit or remove only their own message; every edit is visibly marked.
Removal hides content from ordinary members but preserves an auditable moderation record.
Reporting is confidential; the reported member is not told the reporter identity.
A reporter immediately stops seeing the reported content while the case remains independently reviewable.
Moderators must choose a reason for content removal, mute, ban, restoration, or dismissal.
Room notification is in-app and user-mutable; email and push notifications are out of MVP.
Spam, flooding, impersonation, harassment, hate, sexual exploitation, doxxing, malware, and illegal content are prohibited.
Course-specific questions may occur, but canonical course Q&A remains owned by course-learning and is not replaced by Global Chat.
The product must retain sufficient moderation evidence and expose a policy-controlled retention period before production launch.

failures.outcome: deny room or write action with a clear access state
allow policy-defined reading but deny posting until mute expiry
deny Global Chat access until restored
do not publish and explain the category without exposing moderation internals
one user action produces at most one visible message
the latest valid moderation decision is authoritative and auditable

acceptance: An active authenticated member opens Global Chat, reads recent history, posts text, and another eligible member can observe the same visible message.
A guest or inactive member cannot read or post.
A member can reply, react, mention, edit, and remove only content they own; unauthorized ownership actions are denied.
Unread position and mention indicators advance predictably when the member reads the room.
A report creates one confidential moderation case and hides the reported content for the reporter without deciding guilt.
A moderator can dismiss, remove, mute, ban, escalate, and record a reason; ordinary members see only the resulting public state.
Muted and banned access states are consistently enforced across read and write paths.
Moderator removal and restoration preserve an audit trail.
MVP does not expose direct messages, arbitrary member-created rooms, media uploads, voice/video, or external notifications.
Production launch is blocked until policy owner, moderator coverage, prohibited-content policy, retention period, and escalation response targets are approved.
kpis: percentage of questions receiving a peer reply
launchGates: retention period approved by privacy/legal owner
openDecisions: whether chat-banned members may read or are fully denied
exact edit window and whether edit history is visible to members
exact message and moderation-evidence retention periods
moderator coverage hours and severity-based response targets
minimum account age or trust threshold for posting safe links
whether mentions are available to all members at launch
pilot cohort and numerical KPI thresholds
